question: When will it be double if some capital was invested at the rate of 6 1/4%?

question: If 12th January of 2024 was Friday, then what will be the 7th June of 2025?
explanation: 2024 is a leap year. 12 Jan 2024 to 12 Jan 2025 adds 2 odd days (Sunday). Odd days from 12 Jan 2025 to 7 June 2025: Jan(19) + Feb(28) + Mar(31) + Apr(30) + May(31) + Jun(7) = 146 days = 20 weeks + 6 odd days. Sunday + 6 = Saturday.

question: The ratio of the collection of story books of Rabi and Madhu is 2 : 3 respectively. After purchasing of 6 new books by Madhu the ratio of their books would be 1 : 3. How many books did they have earlier?
explanation: Let Rabi = 2x and Madhu = 3x. 2x / (3x + 6) = 1/3 => 6x = 3x + 6 => 3x = 6 => x = 2. Earlier collection: Rabi = 2(2) = 4, Madhu = 3(2) = 6.

question: A can complete a work in 9 days when B can complete the same work in 6 days. They can complete the work in 3 days if C joins them. How many days will take if C is told to complete the work alone?
explanation: Total work = 18 units. Efficiency: A = 18/9 = 2, B = 18/6 = 3. Together (A+B+C) = 18/3 = 6. Efficiency of C = 6 - (2+3) = 1. C alone takes 18/1 = 18 days.
